messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑look table of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a public holiday that either falls on a weekend or is observed on the nearest weekday, giving you at least three consecutive days off.)

| Date Range | Holiday(s) | Notes |
|------------|------------|-------|
| **Jan 1–2** | New Year’s Day (observed Mon Jan 2) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday, so the holiday was observed on Monday. |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc.) | Family Day is on the 3rd Monday of February. |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday | Good Friday is always on Friday; the following weekend gives a 3‑day break. |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day | Celebrated on the last Monday before May 25. |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (observed Mon Jul 3) | Canada Day fell on Saturday, so the holiday was observed on Monday. |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day | Labour Day is the first Monday in September. |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving | Thanksgiving is the second Monday in October. |
| **Nov 9–11** | Remembrance Day | Remembrance Day is observed on Monday, Nov 11. |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas Day | Christmas Day fell on Monday, giving a 3‑day break. |

> **Boxing Day (Dec 26)** fell on a Tuesday, so it did not create a long weekend.

These are the federal holidays that produced long weekends in Canada during 2023. If you’re building a holiday‑planning app, you can use this list as a starting point and add any provincial holidays that might affect your users’ schedules.
